sources.title: HiveTraceGuard-Pro: A Compact Generative Guardrail for Prompt Injection ...
sources.snippet: HiveTraceGuard-Pro is a 0.6B generative guardrail LoRA-tuned from Qwen3-0.6B for binary safe/unsafe decisions on the final user or assistant turn. It targets prompt injection, jailbreaks and surface obfuscation in Russian and English, while keeping the same verdict rule for requests and responses.
